remarks: MOVE RIGHT IN! Glenville School District. Immaculate and recently updated, this sunny and freshly painted first floor unit is ready for you! Located at the end of a quiet street near public transportation, shops and restaurants. Offers a fabulous floor plan with living room, dining room and a super handy mudroom with plenty of storage that leads to the eat-in kitchen, featuring granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. The primary en suite is complemented by 2 bedrooms and a full bath, all with ample closet space. Enjoy central A/C and hardwood floors thruout. The expansive LL family room, newly renovated, including a beautiful tile floor, is perfect for family gatherings and boasts a fireplace, bar w/quartz countertops and French doors leading to a beautiful flagstone terrace.
